title: Bank KYC Freeze
subtitle: A fake bank fraud officer says the account will be frozen unless KYC is completed now.
caller_persona: Priya Sharma, Bank Fraud Prevention Unit (simulated)
opening: Namaste, main {bank} ki Fraud Prevention Unit se Priya Sharma bol rahi hoon. Aapke account par ek KYC alert hai.

authority: Namaste, main {bank} ki Fraud Prevention Unit se Priya Sharma bol rahi hoon. Aapke account par KYC alert {case_id} hai.
Main bank ke central verification desk se hoon. Aapka reference {case_id} system me flag hua hai.
Yeh call {bank} ke risk department ki official follow-up hai. Main aapka case handle kar rahi hoon.
fear: Agar KYC aaj complete nahi hua, toh aapka account freeze ho jayega aur salary credit nahi hogi.
Aapke account se ek suspicious transfer detect hua hai. Bank ko turant confirm karna hai.
Freeze hone ke baad branch jaakar bhi 7 din lag sakte hain. Abhi resolve karna better hai.
urgency: Sirf 10 minute ka window hai. Uske baad system automatically account block kar dega.
Main dusre customers ke paas ja rahi hoon. Aapko abhi confirm karna hoga.
Aaj shaam tak update nahi hua toh aapki auto-debit payments fail ho jayengi.
secrecy: Yeh internal investigation hai, branch staff ko bhi mat bataiye. Direct main handle kar rahi hoon.
Please yeh call confidential rakhiye. Family ko batane se panic ho sakta hai.
Aap kisi ko bhi is verification ke baare me mat bataiye, warna case slow ho jayega.
isolation: Please aap ek quiet room me jaaiye. Background me koi bol raha hai toh verification disturb hoga.
Kisi family member ko phone mat dijiye. Bank policy ke tahat sirf account holder se baat allowed hai.
Aap akele hain? Achha, kyunki yeh personal banking matter hai.
small_ask: Bas fake reference {case_id} confirm kar dijiye jo aapke SMS me aaya tha. Koi OTP ya PIN nahi chahiye.
Ek chhota sa step: apne fake KYC alert ka reference {case_id} read kar dijiye. Main note kar lungi.
Sirf haan ya na boliye: fake alert {case_id} aapke paas hai?
shame: Aapko banking basics bhi nahi pata? Isliye fraud ho raha hai. Dhyan se suniye.
Itni padhai ke baad bhi aap KYC process nahi samajhte? Family ko aap par garv nahi hoga.
Aap har cheez par sawaal karte hain, isi wajah se account freeze hota hai.

debrief_tips: A bank will never ask for an OTP, PIN, password, or card number on a phone call.
Hang up and call the number printed on your card or passbook, or visit the branch.
Account-freeze threats are designed to create panic. A genuine bank notice arrives in writing.
Do not share your screen or install a remote-access app for 'KYC'.
synthetic_note: The bank, case ID, and caller in this scenario are fictional.
